prompt_rules.title: Governed scientific handoff
rules: Treat the accepted experiment system specification and digest as executable subject authority: preserve component settings, arm semantics, intervention boundaries, and locked invariants on the production runner path.
A bounded fixture may reduce cost only where the admitted execution profile permits; it must not substitute another model family, operator, input geometry, output space, or scientific subject.
Emit the required implementation observation from that same path so an independent consumer can detect semantic substitution.

prompt_rules.title: Research runner input policy
rules: For `adaos.research.runner.v1`, select input only from the admitted `request.profile_conditions.input_policy.source`.
`deterministic_contract_fixture` runs bounded production conformance without opening the accepted dataset; `accepted_dataset` selects the admitted dataset path.
Do not add a duplicate private selector under `request.conditions` or infer dataset authority from ambient files.

prompt_rules.title: Initial equivalence evidence
rules: When initial equivalence is required, test it on production operators before training with the same admitted input and shared initialization state for both arms.
Enforce the admitted tolerance directly; a declaration, parameter default, or post-training comparison is not equivalence evidence.
